integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and deterministic standard-library rational checker. Canonical marginal limits attributed to original literature; no independent external audit claimed.
limitations: No claim for p=0 or p=1 limiting regimes, multiple clusters, convergence rates, or independent scientific certification. Literature priority remains conditional on indexed and inspected sources; finite experiments alone do not prove infinite claims.
scientific_scope: Uniform random recursive tree; exactly prescribed number of uniformly removed edges; exact rising-factorial moments for all integer n,h,r and Mittag–Leffler root-cluster limit when retained fraction converges to an interior value.
title: Microcanonical root-cluster universality in random recursive tree percolation
